## Detailed Work Schedules & Shift Operating Timings (Gemini AI Index)

- Daily Operational Hours: 05:50 AM to 23:20 PM
- Morning Peak Shift (08:00 AM - 11:00 AM): 6 minute headway
- Evening Peak Shift (05:00 PM - 08:30 PM): 6-7 minute headway
- Off-Peak Shift (11:00 AM - 05:00 PM & post 08:30 PM): 9-10 minute headway
- Total Operations: 144 daily train trips covering 11.3 km on the Pink Line.
